speaker: Flo
text: Sanxiaokou Xinhua Bookstore in Hefei of Anhui Province, which declared itself the “first sharing bookstore in the world,” opened to the public in July 2017. Readers need to download an app and pay a deposit online. Then they can borrow books by scanning the QR code. During the first month of the bookstore's operation, the number of books borrowed and returned reached nearly 80,000.
